shots.focal_element: Large centred count-up number (ending at 250,000,000+) framed by rows of dark pill-shaped query chips; later a white-to-blue gradient triangle labelled 'AI search' resting on an orange 'SEO' bar
shots.typography: Query chips: small lowercase sans-serif in white on near-black rounded pills, each prefixed by a sparkle icon, regular weight, normal tracking. Counter: very large light/regular-weight geometric sans-serif numerals with comma separators and a trailing '+', semi-transparent pale lavender over the gradient, tabular figures. 'AI search' / 'SEO': small medium-weight sentence-case sans in white, centred inside the shapes. Font guess (low confidence): a grotesque in the Inter/Aeonik family.
shots.what_happens: On a dark-to-blue-to-peach radial gradient, a grid of query chips types on character by character (about 72.5-74.5 s) while the rows drift slowly sideways; around 76 s a large number fades in at the centre and counts up rapidly (234,223,736+ -> 246,320,766+ -> 249,623,600+ -> 249,976,456+) and settles on 250,000,000+ by about 78 s, holding while the chip rows keep drifting, under VO w192-w225 ('You can literally search anything... nearly 200 million actual questions... not by synthetic prompts'). Note: the VO says 'nearly 200 million' (w208-w210) while the counter lands on 250,000,000+. At about 85.5 s the chips and number clear to the bare gradient (VO w226 'But AI visibility...'); a gradient triangle labelled 'AI search' drops in tilted and an orange 'SEO' bar rises beneath it, the triangle rotating upright to sit on the bar by about 89.5 s as the VO says 'built on healthy SEO' (w234-w238). The last sampled frame (90.5 s) already shows a zoomed Brand Radar AI Overview table, so the cut to the UI appears to fall inside this shot's span, just before the s016 boundary.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a full-bleed radial gradient, lay out 4 rows of sparkle-prefixed pill chips that type on per character and translate horizontally at slow constant speeds in alternating directions, then fade in a centred tabular-figure counter tweened with an ease-out from about 234M to 250,000,000+, and after a clear-out drop a rotated gradient triangle onto an orange bar with a spring rotate-to-upright.
